gen-almendra-display-gf-saira: Ornate and bookish, with a tall x-height. Almendra Display carries the flourish, while Saira keeps its s-shapes open and its rounded letters reaching high, a plain sans that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-audiowide-gf-ruda: Audiowide sets its tall lowercase in wide-spaced, tile-like glyphs with no thick-thin shift at all, a futuristic look. Ruda's wire-thin lines follow, friendly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Dark, ragged and widely spaced, nothing here is polite. Noto Sans Ol Chiki then does the opposite job, forming solid, tidy word blocks where Eater simply snarls.
gen-almendra-display-gf-savate: Savate reads open and contemporary, its round o nearly as big as a capital. Savate also holds up well when sized a touch larger, while Almendra Display adds its ornate, literary flourish up top.
gen-audiowide-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Audiowide ends every stroke at one measured thickness, giving its tall lowercase a futuristic, tile-like look. Schibsted Grotesk answers with open, friendly e and a shapes.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Eater's lightly modulated strokes look dark and jagged. Noto Sans Old Hungarian stays legible even at tiny sizes, so a modest size will do for the body.
gen-almendra-display-gf-sen: Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut, giving it an ornate, literary tone. Sen, tall and traced in a blunt marker-like line, would read smoothly down a long page.
gen-audiowide-gf-sintony: Audiowide looks bent from a single wire, with tall lowercase and wide gaps between tile-like glyphs. Sintony's chunky midzone grounds it with a smooth, unclogged read.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Eater's strokes sit between monoline and sharp contrast, giving it a dark, aggressive bite. Noto Sans Old Italic does the quieter job, keeping its curve endings apart and its lowercase close to cap height.
gen-almendra-display-gf-sofia-sans: Ornate letters that never pinch shut lead the way. Sofia Sans offers the plain sans counterpoint, its stems and crossbars sharing one thickness while its tall lowercase stands like cut acrylic.
